title: Kelasona | Learning, organized.

sections.body: Bring courses, classes, assessments and student progress together. Give your team more room to teach, and your students a clearer path to learn.
sections.eyebrow: A learning platform for your organization
sections.heading: Good teaching deserves a better workspace.
sections.highlights:
Organize courses and materials
Teach, assign and assess
Review progress and celebrate results

sections.body:
Kelasona connects the work around learning: the materials you share, the classes you schedule, the feedback you give and the progress you follow.

Students know where to go next. Teachers can see who needs support. Administrators keep the organization running.
sections.eyebrow: One place to keep learning moving
sections.heading: From the first class to the final certificate.
sections.highlights:
Students: courses, assignments and results
Teachers: classes, feedback and connected students
Administrators: enrollment, permissions and oversight

sections.body: Start with your content and your people. Keep the day-to-day learning experience connected.
sections.heading: Built around the work your team already does.
sections.highlights:
Courses: organize text, images, video and quizzes into sections.
Classes: manage schedules, meeting links and class feedback.
Assessments: use choice, cloze, essay and audio questions.
Assignments: collect documents and written work, then share comments.
Progress: follow completion and publish results and PDF certificates.
Communication: keep messages, notifications and support in the same place.

sections.body: Use AI-assisted analysis for essays and audio alongside answer-key scoring. Review the draft, adjust the feedback and publish when you are ready. Students only see the results you release.
sections.heading: Give feedback with more context.
sections.highlights:
Audio transcription for review
Per-question feedback and recommendations
Reviewer control before results are published

sections.body: Customization, organization logos and publishing tools are planned next. These features are not available yet; this is the direction we are building toward.
sections.heading: More room for your organization's identity.
sections.highlights:
Your branding and logo
More options to customize your learning space
Blogs to share your organization's stories

sections.body: Explore what Kelasona can bring to your organization. Already have an account? Sign in to continue learning.
sections.eyebrow: For schools, learning centers and training teams
sections.heading: Make space for your next learning program.
